description:
Turn your phone into a hilarious sound effects machine.

Slap it. Tap it. It reacts instantly.
The harder you hit, the louder and funnier the sound.

SlapPhone is a fun prank app packed with funny sounds, meme reactions, and interactive sound effects that respond to your touch and motion.

---

🔥 KEY FEATURES

• Slap Detection (Motion-Based)
Hit your phone and trigger real-time sound effects using motion sensors

• Funny Sound Effects
From screams and goat sounds to flirty and meme reactions

• Multiple Sound Packs
Includes Sexy, Goat, Horror, Rage, Meme and more

• Break Mode (Focus Timer)
Set a timer and try not to touch your phone
Every tap triggers annoying and funny sounds

• Instant Feedback
Ultra fast audio response with haptics for satisfying interaction

---

😂 PERFECT FOR

• Prank apps and funny moments
• Meme content and reels
• Stress relief and boredom
• Friends, parties, and office fun

---

🎧 SOUND CATEGORIES

• Funny sounds & meme reactions
• Goat screams & animal chaos
• Horror screams & jump sounds
• Punch, slap & impact effects
• Flirty and playful reactions

---

If you love funny sound apps, prank tools, or weird interactive games, SlapPhone is for you.

Download now and turn every slap into a reaction.
